title: Power Apps: speech as an input source for form fill assistance in model-driven apps

reasons: published before the check existed: kept live with a notice while a corrected version is prepared

summary: Hold: the briefing promises that transcripts are not stored, but the roadmap only makes that promise about recordings. The app configuration path omits Features, an API is incorrectly reported as undocumented, and the asserted relationship between speech and existing controls is not established by Microsoft documentation.

claims.claim: The transcript is not stored.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill assistance" "transcript" "stored"; "form fill" "speech" "transcript". Read form-filling-assistance and faq-from-filling-assistance; neither states transcript retention. The roadmap only says recordings are not saved.
claims.fix: Replace 'the transcript is not stored' with 'the roadmap says recordings are transient and not saved; transcript storage and retention are not yet documented'. Do not extend the audio-recording statement to transcripts.

claims.claim: Speech is sent for processing.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Apps form fill assistance speech microphone disable speech control transcript stored browser permissions. Read form-filling-assistance and its responsible AI FAQ; neither describes speech processing or transmission.
claims.fix: Replace this processing assertion with 'The roadmap says a transcript supplies form entry; the speech processing architecture is not yet documented.'

claims.claim: Fields with column security are not supported for suggestions.

claims.claim: Device and browser permissions govern microphone access for this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill assistance" "microphone" "permissions". Read form-filling-assistance and its FAQ. Results document Windows speech APIs, Edge Web Speech and canvas microphone controls, not this model-driven-app speech feature.
claims.fix: Replace with 'Microphone permission requirements for this speech feature are not yet documented.' Do not imply that documentation for canvas controls or a particular browser establishes this feature's controls.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The environment form fill assistance control is in Power Platform admin center under Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Data entry.
claims.quote: The primary admin control for form fill assistance is moving to the Power Platform admin center under Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Data entry. ... This change is gradually rolling out.
claims.fix: Keep the path, but add a control note that this move is gradually rolling out. Explain that selecting the setting opens a panel to select the environment and Edit setting, as described at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/copilot/copilot-hub.

claims.claim: No API equivalent is documented for the new Data entry environment control.
claims.quote: Searched: "Data entry" "form fill" PowerShell API; "form fill assistance" "PowerShell" "disable". Read form-filling-assistance Admin control, settings-features AI form fill assistance, and copilot-hub; no API for the new control found.

claims.claim: Smart paste and the form fill toolbar are configured at Model-driven app designer > Settings (app properties).
claims.quote: When you select Settings from the command bar, select Features to enable or disable model-driven app features for the app. ... Form fill assist toolbar.
claims.fix: The descriptive name 'Model-driven app designer' is not the problem; the missing Features step is. Replace the path with 'app designer > Settings > Features > Form fill assist toolbar' for the documented toolbar control, and state that app changes require Save and Publish. Document Smart paste separately using its setting definition if its designer label is not shown.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls: app row and closing 'No API is documented'
claims.claim: No API is documented for the Smart paste and form fill toolbar app settings.
claims.quote: saveSettingValue: Adds or updates the setting app value for the current app or the setting environment value for the current environment.
claims.fix: Replace this absence claim: the cited form fill article identifies FormPredictSmartPasteEnabled and FormFileUploadEnabled as app settings and links to the settings mechanism; its developer reference documents saveSettingValue with overrideScope 2 for app values and also links SaveSettingValue Web API. Populate the app API side using that documented mechanism, and restrict any remaining API absence statement to the new Data entry control.

claims.where: controls[2].ui and controls[2].api; Governance controls: speech row
claims.claim: No speech-specific switch is documented on the UI or API surface.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill assistance" "speech" "disable"; "form fill assistance" "speech" "admin" "setting". Read form-filling-assistance, settings-features, copilot-hub and the responsible AI FAQ; no speech-specific UI or API control found.

claims.claim: Speech input follows the existing form fill assistance setting, so turning that setting off removes speech input.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill assistance" "speech" "admin" "setting"; "form fill assistance" "speech" "disable". Read form-filling-assistance, settings-features and copilot-hub; none connects the planned speech source to a specific existing setting.
claims.fix: Replace the speech-row note and the definitive shutdown statement with 'Microsoft has not yet documented which existing controls govern the speech source.' Keep the general form fill controls clearly distinguished from confirmed speech-specific governance.

claims.claim: There is no way to allow text and file sources while blocking the microphone.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill assistance" "speech" "disable"; "form fill assistance" "speech" "admin" "setting". Read form-filling-assistance, app-properties and copilot-hub; none states that independent blocking is impossible.
claims.fix: Replace with 'A separate speech-source control is not yet documented as of November 2026.' Documentation silence does not establish that selective blocking is impossible.

claims.claim: Legacy environment feature settings are being removed as controls move to the new location and app settings.
claims.quote: Admin controls for the AI form fill assistance feature are changing. The primary admin control moves to Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Data entry. ... The following settings are removed from the Environment > Settings > Features page.

claims.claim: Column-level Allow form fill assistance is the finest control for this speech change.
claims.quote: Searched: "form fill assistance" "column" "control" "granular"; speech admin setting queries. Read form-filling-assistance and copilot-hub, plus create-edit-field-portal search excerpt; column control exists, but speech applicability and finest granularity are not stated.
claims.fix: Replace with 'Allow form fill assistance is a documented column-level control for current form fill suggestions; Microsoft has not yet confirmed its behavior for speech input.' Remove the unsupported superlative.

claims.claim: The speech feature is available in Worldwide only.
claims.quote: Searched: "Power Apps" "form fill assistance" "speech" "Worldwide". Read roadmap record and form-filling-assistance; Worldwide is listed, but no exclusion of other clouds is stated.
claims.fix: Replace both instances of 'Worldwide only' with 'The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant); other clouds are not listed.'

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist directs readers to disable Allow form fill assistance for sensitive columns, but the controls table has no column-property row.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Switch off the Allow form fill assistance column property for sensitive columns.' Controls table: environment data entry, app smart paste/toolbar, and speech-specific switch only.
claims.fix: Add a row for the existing column-level Allow form fill assistance property, citing https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/maker/data-platform/create-edit-field-portal#create-a-column. The documentation permits disabling it for sensitive columns and labels it preview; make clear speech-specific applicability is not yet confirmed.
